duplicate_policy: Retain every source row; count each exact experiment/scan/class/slice/x/y tuple once for annotation accounting and each experiment/scan once for classification.
zero_policy: All-zero TB rows are absent-location placeholders for authentic benign cases; they are never lesion points or masks. Other all-zero classes are rejected.
coordinate_policy: Filename and bounds checks only. RadiAnt/CT-GAN axis conventions and index base still require image-space confirmation; no automatic xy swap or mask creation.
